tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi sgrub dkyil lhan cig tu bsdebs pa lū hi dgongs rgyan bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra ye/ rje btsun mchog dang go ram chen po dang / /dkon mchog zung dang a mes zhabs sogs kyis/ /legs gsungs 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub dkyil rnams/ /lhan cig lū hi'i lugs ltar bshad kyis nyon/ /de la 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi sgrub dkyil nag 'gros bklag chog tu bkod na/ de yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bde mchog lū nag gi zur 'debs khyad par bzhi ldan las/ de la 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i nag po dkyil chog tu mi gsal ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa cung zad brjod na/ zhes dang / thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis bde mchog lū nag gi bsnyen yig las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag gi bsnyen pa'i lag len la lugs gnyis po gang la byas na'ang 'dra mod/ zhes dang / shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyis lū nag dbang bzhi mtshams sbyor las/ yang lū hi pa ltar na/ 'dir grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas zhes pa'i tshab tu/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas zhes dang / slob ma sta gon gyi gnas gsum bsrung ba la srin lag gi khrag mi dgos/ 'jug pa'i skabs su lha bskyed cing go cha bcings pa'am go cha'i sngags rnams dang / dang po'i lha bskyed pa'i phyi nang gi lha rnams dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo ston pa'i sku mdog zhal phyag lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ dbang gi rjes su yang de ltar khyod rnams gyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa'i rjes su 'brang nas sogs dang / slob ma la bya ba'i gong 'og gzhan rnams ni 'dra ba nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i nag po dkyil chog la lū hi pa'i khyad chos rnams 'gyur nas nyams su len dgos pas na/

de la don bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa dang / brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang / mjug gi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i bsnyen pa la sogs pa ste/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i nag po dkyil chog tu blta'o/ /sgrub thabs lū hi pa ltar bya/ spyi don gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa la/ sa chog sta gon/ thig gi 'brel ba/ tshon bri ba/ bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa/ mchod pa 'jug pa dang bdun gyi dang po sa chog dgos pas phyogs la dkyil 'khor bzhin bya'o/ /mngon rtogs bsgyur dgos rnams lū hi pa ltar bya/ gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa la sa chog byas na sta gon dkyil chog bzhin bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa la sogs par sa chog mi dgos/ de la sta gon ni/ gnas khang phyags dar dang gtsang sbras thon par byas shing / yid du 'ong ba der bla bre dang yol bas brgyan/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris sku dgram/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'og nas 'byung ba ltar las thig gi cha dbye ba'i steng du 'god sngags dang mthun par 'bras la sogs pa'i tshom bu bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang / las kyi rdo rjes dbus su dri yi thig le gru bzhi dang gzhan rnams la zlum por byas pa'i steng du/ dkyil 'khor du byang shar du sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu gcig rnams bkod/ de nas rgyas par na lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod par byed/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor de'i mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar lhor/ 'jig rten pa'i/ lho nub tu mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog de nas g.yon skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga phyogs mtshams re re bkod pas/ zhal zas 'jig rten pa'i nub drang por yong ba spyi mchod sgos mchod ni/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas gsum tshan pa re re byas pas g.yon skor du 'dod snam gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshan pa re re bkod pa/

bde chen 'khor lo nas dam tshig 'khor lo'i bar gyi sgos mchod/ de'i nang dkyil 'khor gyi shar nub tu tshan pa re bshams pa gtso bo yab yum ste sgos mchod bsdus pa'i lugs dang / dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyi dus sta gon gyi skabs 'dir sgos mchod rgyas pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa drug cu rtsa gnyis phyag len la mdzad pas/ de'i shoms lugs ni sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis tshom bu'i phyi nas bzung gtso 'khor rnams yab yum so sor 'bul ba'i shar nub kyi tshangs thig steng la g.yon skor du spos/ mar me zhal zas gsum tshar dgu dgu bshams pa shar du gtso bo yab dang / nub tu yum nas brtsam sgo ma'i bar gyi'o/ /lho byang gnyis kyi mtshams thig steng la gsum tshan brgyad brgyad bshams pa lā mā dang gzugs can ma nas sgo ma'i bar gyi'o/ /mtshams bzhi'i zur thig steng la gsum tshan bdun bdun bshams pa thugs 'khor ba'i mtshams bzhi nas dam tshig 'khor lo'i gshin rje bstan ma sogs mtshams ma bzhi'i bar gyi'o/ /de ltar dgod pas drug cu rtsa gnyis tshang / sa lha'i tshom bu'i mdun du tshan pa gcig dang / gtor chung gcig rnams bshams pa'o/ /gzhan bzlas gtor dang chos skyong gi gtor ma la sogs pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho nas byang shar gyi bar ram yang na gzhan du bsham kyang chog mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ mchod gtor de dag kyang rgyu bzang zhing 'byor pa gtsang sbra che ba bkod pa mdzes pa phyag len phra mo tshun chad ma nyams par bshams/ gzhan yang rol mo'i tshogs dang 'og tu dgos pa'i phur pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lnga rin chen la sogs pa'i snod 'brus bkang ba la go rim ma 'khrul par btsugs pa dang / gos zung ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ slob ma sta gon dgos na de dag gi ches/ slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng bum gdan la rnam rgyal g.yon/

las bum g.yas/ ḍā ma ru/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du byas la/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du sngon 'gro gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ ces dang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtse'i nang mchod nas gtor la oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing / phaiṃ/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra a ra ri hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ ngag tu/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsa un+mā da a pasmā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i dam ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thaiṃ waṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñja tha/ dzi ghā tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing srin lag gis nang mchod kyang dbul la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing / lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang /

/brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pa/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la zhes gsung rgyun bde zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ nad med tshe ring dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams rgyas zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang / 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na slob ma gzhug cing sogs skabs ltar bya/ srung ma'i dbang po khyod rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/

sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad srung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar du srung ba dang sdong grogs mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la brkyangs te gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du song zhig rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol la oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod do/ /gnas yo bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta bab bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ mchod rdzas rnams a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang sna tshogs rol mo byas te/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pas byin dbab bo/ 'di ma gtogs mchod pa gzhan rnams la gaṇ+ḍe ra ni dang rol chen mi dgos/ tshar gsum gyis dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs la/ gnyis pas mchod yul de rnams kyis gnas khang byin rlabs/ gsum pas mchod rdzas la sogs pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab par bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil chog las/ maṇ+ḍal phul la lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab la/ zhes 'byung bas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bya ste/

de'i tshul brjod na mchod g.yog pas/ phyag gsum btsal nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa dbul/ de yang / oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ nas/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang 'dir 'dus pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal te/ ting phor nas kyis bkang la reng bu btsugs pa slob dpon gyi mdun du phul/ gzhan der 'dus pa rnams la me tog bkram mo/ /yang phyag gsum btsal la me tog dang bcas pas thal mo snying khar sbyar la gral gyi mthar langs te/ ngag tu/ kun bzang rnam sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang / yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis gsog bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ /me tog gtor/ de 'dra ba lan gsum tshar ba dang / phyag gsum btsal nas/ slob dpon ma yin pa gzhan tshogs pa rnams la me tog bsdus/ yang phyag gsum btsal nas/ thams cad kyi thun mong du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod la oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs gong bzhin brjod la slob dpon gyi phyag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis tshom bu kha gsos te/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud la rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin zab mo ma skyes pa/

bskyed pa brtan pa byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing reng bu maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su btsugs/ mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor gyi drung ga la ba der phul nas bzhag la/ slar yang phyag gsum btsal te gral la 'khod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la snyom par 'jog par zhu/ zhes bskul te/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang / dkyil 'khor 'dus nas rang gtso bo yab yum phyag bcu gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa la go cha gsum gyis bsrung ba'i bar kun mkhyen rin po che'i bde mchog sgrub thabs mngal sgom sbyong tshul bzhin nyams su len dgos pas de'i tshul ni/ 'di'i mngon par rtogs pa la bzhi te/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i dang / spyod lam gyi dang / gtor ma'i dang / kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa la mchod pa dang / bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum yod pa las 'dir rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dang / don chen po ye shes kyi tshogs bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ gsog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gzhan don du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa dang / tshogs gsog pa la rten khyad par can zhig dgos pas phung po khams dang skye mched bzhi sbyang bsgyur dang tshogs bsag dngos dang 'brel ba'i tshogs bsag bcu gsum gyis tshogs bsag pa dang / don chen po ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/

skyabs yul gsal 'debs ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ /chos po ti'i rnam pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun du mos la/ bzhugs par gyur ces gsungs rgyun/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems kyi gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi sku ru gyur pa yi/ /bdag ni he ru kar byas nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/

/go 'phang mchog la 'god par bya/ /gsum/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi pad+mar babs/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis kyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gyi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas gshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pa lā ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi dho me bhā wā/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wā/ a nu rak+to me bha wā su po ṣ+yo me bha wā/ sarba sid+dhi m+mi pra yats+tsha/ sarba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca badz+ra he ru ka ko bha wā ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/

/dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ bsgom pa ni lus lhar byin gyis brlabs pa sku'i dga' ba yin la/ phyag len la dril bu pa ltar sku'i dga' ba'i rjes su yod na bdud rtsi ril bu myang / med na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la myang / de'ang med na yod par bsam ste 'og gtor ma'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlab nas myang bar bsam la gsung gi dga' ba la 'jug pa gsungs pa de ltar byas la/ de nas ngag tu/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa ni/ ngag sngags su byin gyis brlabs pa gsung gi dga' ba'o/ /de nas rang gi snying khar a dkar po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i sems hūm̐ du gyur pa'i zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo bo mnyam nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su bsgom pa ni sems ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabs pa thugs kyi dga' ba'o/

/de nas/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung ste rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po nas phar la song / dang po shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ de nas phyogs bcu'i khams gsum gyi gnas thams cad khyab ste/ 'gro ba rigs drug dang skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur par bsgom la/ slar 'od zer hūm̐ la thim zhes gsungs rgyun la bzhag ste thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o bsdus ngag tu/ su khe bha wān+tu/ zhes brjod de gsung gis byin gyi rlabs pa'o/ /lus kyis g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor zhing se gol brdabs te sku yis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer ljang khu byung ste/ g.yon zhal ljang khu nas phar song / dang por byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ de nas phyogs bcu'i khams gsum gyi gnas thams cad khyab ste 'gro ba rigs drug dang skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur par bsam la/ 'od zer slar bsdu ba dang byin rlabs gzhan gnyis ni 'dra'o/ /yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po byung ste rgyab zhal dmar po nas phar song / dang por nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ de nas phyogs bcu'i khams gsum gyi gnas thams cad khyab ste/ 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa'i dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par gyur par bsam pa sogs 'gre'o/ /yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer ser po byung ste g.yas zhal ser po nas phar song / dang por lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ de nas phyogs bcu'i khams gsum gyi gnas thams cad khyab ste/ 'gro ba rigs drug dang skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur par bsam pa sogs 'dra la/

sngags dang phyag rgya rnams ni lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag gi lus thams cad gang bas/ bdag nyid kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag par bsgoms pa ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba yin la/ de nas 'od zer rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs par bsgoms pa ni gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang ba yin la/ de nas thams cad kyang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur par bsgom pa ni sngon la gzhan gyi gzhi bsgrur ba'o/ /de nas bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba ni/ de rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ phung khams skye mched lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni zhes gsung rgyun nga rgyal du byas te/ de yang rang gi gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa ni dpal he ru ka mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ kha 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad dbang phyug rdo rje/ sa'i khams ltung bar byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod par byed ma/ me'i khams 'gugs par byed ma/ rlung gi khams gar gyi dbang phyug nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can du gyur par bsam mo/ /gsum pa la bcu gsum las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ slar yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar steng gi cha la bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang / 'og gi cha la 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs so/

/de nas na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rdor thal dpral bar zhes pas bla ma dang / na snying khar maḥshrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor la phyag bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra rdor thal/ maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hās mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hās zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ bdug spos/ badz+ra a lo kā+e āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul lo mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ ces brjod la se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ oṃ sar+b+ba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā wārta ā wārta hoḥ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ a bhisma ra ye s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharmā dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sha dha ye maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ sū ṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ba len+dha ban+dha sa s+d+yā ba le na tsa ye swā hā zhes brjod nas phyag rgya bkrol te se gol lan gnyis brdab par bya'o/

/gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi spyan sngar so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do/ /bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag bdag gi dus 'di nas zhes gsung rgyun/ ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lnga pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ bdag gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs thams cad blang zhing bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /drug pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ bdag gis so so'i skye bo dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /bdun pa sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o/ /brgyad pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ bdag gis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa de dag thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/ /dgu pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag gis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /bcu pa lam la gnas pa ni/

bdag gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam gyi rim pa gnyis la yang dag par gnas par bgyi'o/ /bcu gcig pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gis de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig bcu gnyis pa gnang ba nod pa ni tshogs zhing de dag gi zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gnas pa 'di ni legs par gnas pa yin gyi/ gnas pa 'dis gnas na mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs par bsam mo/ /bcu gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ bzhi pa la gsum ste/ sa phyogs bgegs dang bral bar bya ba/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bya ba/ bgegs tshar bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las shar du kha gdong ma sngon mo/ steng du khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ 'og tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje che ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa drag mo shin tu khros pa'i gzugs can rnams spros te bgegs tshar bcad pa'i las mdzad par bsam la/ lus kyis g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor zhing phyogs de dang der se gol brdab te/ de yang oṃ sum+bha/ zhes pas shar dang / oṃ sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas steng dang / oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas byang dang / oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya zhes pas nub dang / gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas 'og dang / oṃ ā na ya hoḥbhā ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas lhor se gol brdabs/

de bzhin du shar lho nas brtsams te sngags tshan pa bzhi po rim bzhin brjod cing se gol brdab te/ sems kyis pho nya spro ba dang / ngag tu sngags brjod pa dang / lus kyis se gol brdab pa gsum dus mnyam par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa phyogs der raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar gyi rwa sngo ba/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsgom la ngag tu oṃ me di ni badz+ri bha wā ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas byin brlabs/ yang 'od zer khor yug tu 'phros pas rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pas rwa ba dang / rdo rje 'phred la song bas dra bar gyur par bsgom la ngag tu oṃ badz+ra pra kā rā hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ yang 'od zer steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba'i nang du rdo rje'i gur du gyur par bsgom la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ yang de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla rer gyur par bsgom la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros pas de dag gi phyi rol tu mda'i dra ba mde rtse rno ba phyir bstan pa srid pa'i rtse mo la phyir thug par gyur par bsgom la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros pas de dag gi phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me ri rab tu 'bar bar gyur par bsgom la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ ḍaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas byin rlabs te sngags de dag lan gsum gsum brjod cing / de'i tshe g.yon pas sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor nas se gol brdab par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar gyi pho nya rnams kyis bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems la bkod nag po'i rigs kha cig bsgral te bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas par/

bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug te 'ongs nas me ris nang rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol mda'i dra ba'i 'og na 'obs kyi kha khyer la bkod par bsam la/ bdag gi snying kha nas phur bu bcu spros te pho nya rnams kyi lag tu gtad pas phyogs skyong bcu'i spyi bor btab par bsam la/ ngag tu oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sar+b+ba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sar+b+ba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sar+b+ba bigh+naṃ kā ya wākā tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa zhes brjod de lus kyis phur bu bsgril ba'i tshul bya/ yang bdag gi snying kha nas tho ba bcu spros te pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad par bsam la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra mud ka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa zhes brjod de phur bus spyi bo nas brdungs par bsam/ de nas de dag gi rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig ces brjod de ro rnams 'obs kyi nang du bskyur bar bsam mo/ /de nas pho nya rnams las rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag tu med par sprul te mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas rdo rje'i dra mig nas ro stod thon te/ sgrub pa po'i ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar chad srung bar mdzad do zhes gsung rgyun bsam mo/ /gnyis pa don chen po ye shes kyi tshogs ni phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma tsam du shes par byas la zhes pa gsung rgyun bsgom la/ oṃ swa bhā wā shud+dha sar+b+ba dhar+m+mā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ sgyu ma yang mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du de la gyur zhes gsung rgyun/ bsgom nas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis ste/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa dang / mchod pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa/

ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba/ go cha bcing ba/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor dag pa dang bcas pa sgom pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang bcas pa bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu brdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin can gru bzhi pa lcogs brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ g.yon bskor gyis a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥphrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes su mos par bya'o/ /de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo g.yas bskor gyis ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa dha phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su mos par bya'o/ /de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su mos par bya/ nyi mas mtho gang tsam gyis ma reg par steng du tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐ yum gyi mkha' dag pa'i ngo bo pad+ma/ yab kyi byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba/

sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ pad+ma la thim/ pad+ma zla ba la thim/ zla ba hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da dmar skya shin tu phra zhing brjid pa/ ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ 'khyog cing 'khyog cing myur du 'bab pa ni sgra yin la/ des nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phug nas hūm̐ gi yi ge'i tshul la thim pa'i rkyen gyis nyi zla sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes su mos par bya/ de las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor cig char du gyur pa ni zhes gsung rgyun bsgom zhing rim gyis gsal gdab par bya ste/ de yang gtso bo nas dur khrod kyi bar bang phar rim bzhin gsal gdab kyang chog la 'dir thog mar rten gsal gdab pa ni/ ri rab kyi steng srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po'i kha khyer dang / de'i steng du mda' yab la zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ mda' yab kyi steng du rin po che'i dra ba seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng du phyogs re rer rab tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i lha mo bzhis mchod rdzas dpag tu med par thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang /

ri dwags dang gdugs dang ldan pa gzhan yang rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / rin po che dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang /nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ mtshams bzhir sman dang bcud sna tshogs dang bdud rtsis gang zhing / lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul par g.yogs pa/ me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i dpag bsam shing gis kha rgyan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng thog sku 'khor gyi ka ba la brten nas phub pa/ de'i nang du in+d+ra nī li'i sa gzhi la 'khor lo rim pa bzhi/ mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i tshul du gnas pa'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang ka ba dang gdugs dang thog phub can/ bar pa gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i rwa dang ka ba gdung dang thog phub can/ nang ma thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang ka ba dang gdung thog phub can/ lte ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa gri gug gis mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang ka ba dang gdung dang thog phub dang bcas pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres pa/ dbus phyur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis spras pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'khrug pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu shar phyogs su gtum drag byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ shar lhor nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod rnams su rim pa de nyid kyis/ brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/

chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang dbyug gu gsum pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa/ ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung lha ljang khu sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan gyis brgyan zhing / rang dang 'dra ba'i rig mas g.yon nas brten pa/ spyi bo'i bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ shi ri sha a shwad tha/ kaṃ ko la/ tsu da/ ka ran dza/ la da sa kartaṃ/ sar ti pa tā/ bha dra ste shing chen po brgyad/ de rnams la brten pa'i sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad dang / nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ hu lun ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong / pad+ma chen po ste klu brgyad dang / sgra grag pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba 'bab pa/ drag po/ 'khrigs pa ste sprin chen po brgyad dang / gzhan yang chu bo chen po brgyad dang / me chen po brgyad/ mchod rten chen po brgyad gnas shing / sprul pa dang rang brgyud pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / grub pa dang / rig pa 'dzin ma dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / gnod sbyin dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / ce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod kyis bskor ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog 'byung ba bzhi dag cing tshad med pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa bzhi dang / 'phrin las bzhi'i ngo bo zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang /

rgyab dmar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur ba'i sku mdog sngon po/ khams gsum gyi sems can la gzigs shing / dus gsum gyi dngos po mkhyen pas zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis lugs 'byung dang / lugs las ldog pa thugs su chud cing / 'pho ba bcu gnyis rnam par dag pas phyag bcu gnyis kyis ye shes lnga ro gcig pa'i rdo rje dang / stong pa gnyis kyi sgra sgrog pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ gti mug spangs pa'i de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ mchog tu dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul bar mdzad pa'i g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ nyes pa thams cad gcod pas bzhi pa na dgra satwa/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad gcod pa'i lnga pa na gri gug srid pa gsum gyi nyes pa 'joms pa'i drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po dang mi 'bral bas g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bde ba chen po skyong bas bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes sems can gyi rgyud la 'ching bas lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad gcod pas drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi khams la bzhugs pa'i phyir g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin brkyang bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' dus mtshan ma dmar mo shin tu rid pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gan rkyal du mnan pa/ shes rab chen pos gang zag dang chos su mi 'dzin pa'i phyir zhabs g.yon pa shes rab kyi rang bzhin bskum pas 'khor ba'i mtha' 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas pa ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha phub tu mnan pa tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa/

byang chub kyi sems gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang / 'phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i 'tshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan yongs su rgyas pas dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang / ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ log par lta ba 'joms pa'i zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing bdud bzhi spangs pas mche ba gtsigs pa/ rna rgyan bzod pa/ mgul rgyan sbyin pa/ gdub bu tshul khrims/ ske rags brtson 'grus/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo bsam gtan/ thal chen gyi rgya dang mchod phyir thogs shes rab ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bo rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ bdud 'joms pa la dpa' zhing gzung 'dzin spangs pas stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rgyas shing nyon mongs pas gzir pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas pas/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa drag shugs 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar mo/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis kyi g.yon pas bde ba chen po yongs su skyong bas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pas rtog pa thams cad gcod pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad du sdigs par byed pa/ kun tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol bas skra grol ba/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/

rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ bdud thams cad skrag par byed pa'i bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ bde bar gsol ba'i khrag gsol ba la dgyes shing / bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ thabs dang mi 'bral pa'i byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ snang ba dang / thabs dang / lhag mthong dang snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang shes rab dang / gzhi gnas dang / bde ba chen po'i ngo bo yum yin zhing / zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun tu kha sbyor ba/ ye shes chen po'i mes phyi nang gi gdon thams cad bsreg par byed pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi phyag bzhis g.yas gnyis na ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'di ni rgyab phyogs nas tshur bgrang ba'i dbang du byas pa ste mdun ma gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa bzung ba'o/ /skra grol ba gcer bu g.yas brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i steng na thod pa gnas pa ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /de'i phyi rol thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs pu lī ra ma yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum mo/ /byang rtsibs dza lan dha rar ma hā kaṃ kā la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub rtsibs u rgyan du kaṃ kā la dang / 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs ar bu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma/ shar lhor go dā wa ri su ra wi ri dang / brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub rā me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/

byang shar mā la war rdo rje'i sku dang / shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing / sa bla spyod pa thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ /de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs kā ma rū par aṃ gu ri dang / e rā wa ti/ byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo/ /nub rtsibs tri sha ku nir dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang / chang thung ma/ shar lhor ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang / sh+ya ma de wi/ lho nub lam pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma/ byang shar hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang / kha ga na na ste gsung gi 'khor lo lha rnams kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing / sa steng spyod pa gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ /de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri ha de wār rin chen rdo rje dang / khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub rtsibs puṣ+pe raṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang / shaun+ḍi ni/ lhor rtsibs su wārnan dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los bsgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dkar po sa 'og na bskyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing / sa 'og bskyod pa sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis mtshan pa'i cod paṇa dang /

phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ sku la phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyangs pas gnas pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa drag mo'i gzugs can la skra grol bas rnam par mdzes pa/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pa/ gcer bu'i mchog rgyan lnga dang tshangs pa'i skud pas brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i do shal dang ska rags gsil gsil gyi sgra sgrog pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kyi gzhi'i shar sgor kha gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa yi dwags kyi gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas bzhugs shing / sems can gyi don la mngon par brtson pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas rang gi bsgom pa'i lha dang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lha la mchog dman du lta ba spangs pa dang / dngos grub myur tu 'gugs pa'i phyir pho nya bsre ba ni/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa 'di ni phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi yul rnams yin la/ de nyid 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi gzhal yas khang pa yin zhing /

de yang chos kyi sku las byung ba'o/ /zhes yul la yul gyis zhen pa dang / yang bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis yin zhing dkyil 'khor sngags skyes 'di nyid 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi sprul pa'i sku rnams yin la/ de nyid 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis yin zhing / de yang chos kyi sku las byung ba yin no/ /zhes lha la lha'i zhen par bya'o/ /'di ni blo mchog gi dbang du byas la/ blo 'bring gis 'khor lo re re nas bsre ba dang / blo tha mas rtsibs re re nas bsre ba'i tshul yang shes par bya'o/ /de nas lam la som nyi spangs pa'i phyir byang chub kyi phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa ni/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni ma hā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni pū ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni aṃ ku ri dang au ra wa ti'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de wi'o/

/shes rab kyi stobs ni rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag gi byang chub kyi yan lag ni mig mi bzang dang kha ga na na'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs chen ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'o/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi ni'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni rnam par snang mdzad 'khor los bsgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa'i gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug pa'i gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi'i gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gi gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyes pa ni ya ma dā dhī'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyed pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /zhes brjod cing dran par bya'o/ /de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la dman pa go na de'i gnyen por phar ngag tu sbyar ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ yang lha'i sku la gdos bcas rnam pa lta bur zhen pa skye na/ mkha' 'gro ma ni lus rjes su dran pa'o/

/zhes sogs tshur ngag tu sbyar ba yang shes par bya'o/ /de gnyis ka'ang blo tha ma'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ blo mchog gi ni/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha sum cu so bdun po 'di nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa mdor bsdus pas kyang chog go /gnyis pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor dag pa dang bcas pas bsgom pa ni/ 'og rlung gi lte ba'i aṃ las yar phul naṃ tshul ltag pa'i rlung gis spyi gtsug gi haṃ yas mar phul ba ni sgra ste/ de ltar sgra tshul gnyis snying khar 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis/ skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor cig car du gyur pa ni/ rim gyis gsal gdab par bya ste/ de yang rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/ lte ba chu/ snying kha sa/ rgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod/ dpral ba dang / ltag pa/ rna ba gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje/ klad pa dkar po zla ba/ klad khyim dmar po nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar na gnas pa'i haṃ ni yi ge hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / mchu dang / rgyu long la sogs pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan yin te/ de ltar rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab/ de nas snying kha'i nang gi hūm̐ nyid bcom ldan 'das nang gi he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra satwa lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa sgreng ba/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bus spras shing / g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang 'tshog ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas gri gug gis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud cing / gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i do shal dang / rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phyi'i he ru ka'i phyag g.yas kyi dang po la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ /gnyis pa la lā ma ljang khu/ g.yon gyi dang po khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ gnyis pa la gzugs can ma ser mo/ g.yas kyi gsum par khwa gdong ma sngon po/ bzhi pa na 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ lnga pa na khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ drug pa na phag gdong ma ser mo/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/

bzhi pa na gshin rje pho nya g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ lnga pa na gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ drug pa na gshin rje 'jog ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ste/ thams cad kyang zhal phyag sngar bzhin gsal btab/ de nas spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dzā o a go ra de mā ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ sre gri sau pū na si ma ku'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i khams dang rtsa rnams dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams su gyur pa ni spyi bo pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dzā lan dha rar ma hā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa u rgyan du kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag par ar bu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go dā wā rir su ra waṃ ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ra me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas rnams thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la bskyod pa'o/ /mchan khung gnyis ka ma ru par aṃ gu ri dang e ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis o trer rdo rje ral can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma rna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / kha ka ling gar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wi/ mgrin pa lam pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshan dho/ snying kha kān tsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'dom bar hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na na ste nye ba'i mtshan dho rnams gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la bskyod pa'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gṛ ha de wār rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro ha ste 'du ba/

brla gnyis su sū+au raṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shaun ṭi ni/ byin pa gnyis su war+ṇa de bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba sor mo bcu drug na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ /bol gong sin+dhu rar pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhi ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod rnams sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'o/ /khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo thams cad zhes sogs zhal phyag sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ de nas sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ ngag tu oṃ zhes brjod pa'i tshe bdag gis sgom pa'i lus dkyil dang / phyi dkyil gyi sku'i 'khor lo gnyis dang / 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa'i sku'i 'khor lo dang / 'og min na bzhugs pa'i sku'i 'khor lo ste sku'i 'khor lo bzhi dran par bya/ de bzhin du ā zhes brjod pas gsung gi 'khor lo bzhi dang / hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thugs kyi 'khor lo bzhi dang / sar+b+ba wi ri yo gi ni zhes brjod pas dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun dran par bya kā ya zhes brjod pas thams cad kyi sku dang wā ka zhes brjod pas thams cad kyi gsung dang tsit+ta zhes brjod pas/ thams cad kyi thugs dbyer mi phyed snyam du dran par bya/ badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas gnyis su dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin de nyid nga yin no/ /snyam du bsam la oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas thams cad stong pa nyid rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo bdag yin no snyam pa lan gsum du bya'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya zhing / lus kyis lag pa'i mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/

gung mo gnyis dang mthe bong gnyis so sor sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma rnams 'bar ba'i tshul du byas pa'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du bskor/ mig gyen du lta ba dang bcas pas gdong bsgyur/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthil gyis g.yon pa'i bol gong mnan la ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod/ sems kyis snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpral ba nas spros te lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ spyan drangs la tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi mchod dang yid mchod gnyis kyis mchod/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas nye bar byon hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rten dang brten pa so so la thim baṃ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa bsres hoḥzhes brjod pas dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo gyur par bsam nas ngag tu/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sar+b+ba d+dhar+m+ma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod de ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo chos thams cad dag la dag kyang de yi ngo bor dag go /zhes bsam zhing / lus kyi snying khar rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor bar byas nas mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /gsum pa go cha bcing ba ni rgyud dang / lū hu pa'i gzhung las sngon la go cha bcings nas de'i rjes su ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug su gsungs pas/ de bzhin byas kyang chog par gsungs la/ nā ro ta pas shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdams pa dang 'dra bar skabs 'dir gsungs pas ngag tu/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du yab kyi snying khar oṃ haḥdakar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis su bhau ṣaṭa he nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog tu mos par bya/ de bzhin du yum la'ang bsam zhing /

lha thams cad la yang yod par mos pa bya'o/ /yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon po gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ spyi bor hreṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa ljang khu tsan+ti ka ste/ de bzhin du yab la yod par bsam zhing / lha thams cad la yang yod pa mos par bya'o/ /de yang yab yum gnyis su med pas na/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yab rnams gnyis su med par gyur/ bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa ni/ gong gi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa'i skabs kyi phyag rgya dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ phyi dang yid 'byung gis mchod pas mchod/ khyod rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag na bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas zhes brjod spyi gtsug na mar la dbang bskur zhing / ngag tu ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las bde ba chen po'i lha rnams dang dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam ste bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa de la mchod pa ni/

bdag bskyed nang ma'i skabs su sngags dang / phyi dang bdud rtsi dang / mnyes pa dang / yid las byung ba dang / bstod pa'i mchod pa ste drug po 'ba' zhig byed pa yin la/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus su ni phyi mchod kyi rjes la rig ma bcu drug dang / rin chen sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ste dgu byed pa yin de la dang po ni/ lha de dang de gsal gdab pa'i tshul gyis mchod de/ ngag tu oṃ na mo bha ga wa ste wi ri shā ya/ ma hā kalpa ag+ni saṃ ni bhā wa/ dza ḍā mu kuṭ+ṭo tā ya/ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣ+ṇa mu khā ya/ sa hā sra bhuñja bhā su rā ya/ par+shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ byā gh+rā dzi na am+bha rā dha ra ya/ ma hā dhum bra an+dha kā ra wa su ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hra hraḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhī ra an+t+ra/ a pa laṃ bī na/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ ga sar saṃ bā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaṭa dha a kaṭa dha/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā ra hi baṃ/ ār+ya a pa rī dzi ti tre lokya mā ti ma hā bid+yaṃ shwa ri/ sarba bhu ta bha ya bā he ma hā badz+re badz+ra a sha ni a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ṇaṃ trī bh+ra ma ṇi/ sho ṣ+ṇi ro ṣ+ṇi kro dha ka ra li trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe dha ni a pa ra dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra wā ra hi ma hā yo gi naṃ kā me shwa rī kha ge tad+ya thā/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge ha na ha na/ prā ṇāṃ kiṃ ki ni/ khiṃ khi nī/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra haste sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dha ri ṇi/ ma hā si si ta mān+pā sha ni/

ma nu ṣa an+t+rā pro bṛ te/ san ni dh+yaṃ na ra si ra mā la gran ti ta dhā ra ni/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ ha na ha na/ prā ṇan sarba pā shu bā nan/ ma hā lan sa ts+tshe da ni/ kro dha mūrte/ daṃṣ+ṭa ka ra lī ni ma hā mu dre shṝ he ru ka de wa s+ye a gra ma hi ṣi ya ha pra shi te/ sa ha sra bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra ā na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khe biṃ ga la lo tsa ni/ badz+ra sha ḍī re/ badz+ra ā pa ne/ mi li te/ ni mi li te/ he he/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñca muñca/ a d+yāṃ te ma hā yo ṣi ni/ sa ṣi ta/ si dhe/ draṃ dheṃ dheṃ dheṃ/ graṃ graṃ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me ha sa ha sa/ bī re hā hā/ ho ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tre lokya bī nā sa ni/ sha ta sa hā/ pra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri wa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ siṃ ha ru pe kha ga dza ru pe gaḥtri lokya u da ri sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī ra dh+wai te hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha/ ma hā pa shu mo ha ni/ ma hā yo gi shwa ri trāṃ ḍā ki nī sarba lo kā nāṃ ban+dha ni sad+yaḥ pra t+ya ka ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhu ta trā sa ni/ ma hā bī re pa ra ma sid+dhi yo gī shwa ri phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rtsa sngags gnyis gnyis su med pa dang / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha ra swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po gnyis gnyis su med pa dang / oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nye snying gnyis gnyis su med pa dang / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ la me ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ru pa ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces zhal bzhi pa dang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi spel bas/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ak+ṣ+ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ prā sa ya prā sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khar ba rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dru mats+tsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ai rā wa rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra wī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi ra an+t+ra ma la a ba laṃ bhi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhak+ṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sasta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ ga sar paṃ ba tardza ya tardza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+yā ma de wi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā kaṭa d+dha ā kaṭa d+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha tre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzo ṇoṃ dzo ṇoṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khi gā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+ṇau ḍi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pā le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ma hā bīd+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi spel ba dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa ag+ni saṃ ni bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ u luṃ kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma kuṭ+ṭo ka ḍā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwā nā ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā le gra bhi ṣa mu kha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ka ra s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su ḍā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ḍā dhi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ par+shu pā sho d+ye ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dhū tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā grā dzi na am+bha ra dha ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dum bra an+dha ka ra wa su ṣa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes yab kyi bskang brgyad sgom mtshams ma bdun spel mar brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni dngos su bshams pa'am yid kyis bsam pas kyang rung ste/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rang rang gis sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs de nas rang rang gis phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍa la sarba bī ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon phyag tu phul/ de bzhin du sngags kyi dbu zhabs thams cad 'dra bar byas nas/ pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa zhal zas kyi bar du dbul/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i sgrub thabs na phyi mchod la shap+ta'i sngags ma gsungs par ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi gsungs 'dug kyang /

shap+tas chog nang gi mchod pa 'bul tshul rgyas pa gsungs 'dug pas de bzhin nam/ yang na bdag bskyed kyi skabs su spros pa chung ba'i dbang du btang nas rol mo'i sgra sogs dngos su mi mdzad/ phyi mchod la so so'i phyag rgyas chog gsung gi dga' ba'i sngon du nang mchod byin rlabs grub nas 'dir byin rlabs dran byed oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas byas la bdud rtsi 'bul ba yin pas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams la sngags mchod kyi sngags dang mthun pa'i mchod pa bya zhing hūm̐ baṃ la sogs pa sa bon bsdus pa'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul ba bstun pa'i lung ltar bya/ yi ge gsum brjod pas gnas gsum su thig le byas te phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor gsal ba'ang mchod do/ /bzhi pa ni de nas bdag gi lce la bdud rtsi myangs te phyi nang gi lha thams cad dgyes par bsam nas/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lha thams cad kyi zhal nas gsungs par bsam la bdag gis kyang brjod cing / snying khar rnam lnga 'dod skor bya ste mthar 'khyud pa'i steng ka bya'o/ /lnga pa ni tshogs shing gi skabs ltar yid byung gis mchod do/ /drug pa ni yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa sngar sngags mchod kyi skabs su sgo mtshams ma brgyad spel ba de nyid logs su phye nas brjod/ yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā ra hi wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa rā tsī trai lokya ma te ma hā bid+ye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha yā bā he ma hā badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ni a dzi te a pa ra dzi te bā sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+rā ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ni kro dha ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na masatra pa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā ra hi ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod gnyis pa sngags kyi bzlas pa ni/ gsang sngags gang bzlos pa yab kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags 'phreng byung nas yab kyi zhal nas thon te yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi pad+ma nas yab kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i bu gar zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pa'i tshul gyis te/ de yang zhi ba la kha dog dkar po sngags gcig gi ring la gcig 'phreng ba mda'i shugs kyis 'gro ba zhes bya ba dang / rgyas pa la kha dog ser po sngags bung bskyed nas sgro'i chun po lta bu'i tshul gyis 'gro ba zhes bya ba dang / dbang la ni kha dog dmar po sngags gcig gi mjug la gcig gi mgos 'khyud nas 'gro ba ste lcags sgrog lta bu zhes bya ba dang / drag po la ni kha dog nag po yab yum gyi sngags srad bu sgril ba lta bu'i tshul gyis bzlas te/ de yang mchog sgrub pa la rin chen bzhi zhes bya ba/ rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis dang go cha gnyis ste/ bzhi po de dag gang mos pa gnyis su med pa bzlos pa yin la/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni thun mjug la ci rigs pa re bzlos pa yin no/ /dbang bskur ram/ rab gnas sam sbyin sreg gi sngon du bsnyen pa byed na yab yum gyi snying po'i sngags gnyis la khri phrag gsum dang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad la rang rang gi sngags stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya pa rer bzlas/

'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams ni lha re re la rang rang gi yab yum gyi sngags khri phrag gnyis bzlas pa byas nas dbang bskur la sogs pa gang yin pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /bzlas pa bsdu ba na 'phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas brtan byed kyi yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod la/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ srod thun la bar 'dir gtor ma la zhugs nas rdzogs rim sgom pa dang mnyam du nyal ba'i rnal 'byor byed pa yin kyang / de brjod na rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba dang / yi ge bsdu ba dang / thig le bsdu ba gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/ yab kyi lte bar pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros te rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dang / phyi'i he ru ka yab yum nas 'khor lo nang ma nas phar rim gyis je gsal je gsal khams gsum snod bcud thams cad shin tu gsal bar byas la de'i stobs kyis thams cad khrig khrig g.yos par bsam ste/ de rdo khab len gyis lcags g.yo ba zhes bya ba yin no/ /de nas/ khams gsum snod bcud bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de bzhin du srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang dam tshig 'khor lo la/ de sku'i 'khor lo la/ de gsung gi 'khor lo la/ de thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /de snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la de bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal bzhi la thim ste/

dpe gnyis pa lci ba'i dngul chu sdud pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /'bring bsdus gnyis la phyi'i dkyil 'khor med pas khams gsum lus la bsdu ba nyid dpe gnyis pa'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ dpe gsum pa rus sbal yan lag 'khum pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de nas bdag phyi'i he ru ka yum yab la thim/ yab lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yum yab la/ rdo rje snyems ma'ang yab la/ yab snying kha'i hūm̐ la hūm̐ gi gdan zla ba de zhabs kyu la/ zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ de ni dpe bzhi pa skar mda' gcig la gcig thim pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de nas/ thig le de'ang je phra je phra mi dmigs par gyur zhes pa gsungs rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las bzhag par bya ste/ de ni rtsa ba'i dpe lnga pa lan tshwa chu la thim pa zhes bya ba yin te/ de'i ngang la blo ji tsam gnas pa zhig la bzhag la sdang bar 'dod na gong du bstan pa'i he ru ka'i skur langs te/ rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas nang dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud thams cad gsal bar gyur/ thun mjug tu gtor ma yod na skabs 'dir btang la de'i rjes su dag pa dran par bya zhing / med na skabs 'dir dag pa dran par bya ste/ lus kyi ḍā ma ru'i sgra dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ ngag tu 'og nas 'byung ba rnams gsal bar brjod cing sems kyis ma dag pa'i khams dang rgyan cha la sogs pa de dang de lha dang sngags de dang de'i ngo bo yin no snyam du bsam pa las lha dang sngags kyi rnam par bsgom pa ni mi dgos so/ /de'ang brjod par bya ste so dang sen mo la ni khaṇ+ḍa kā pa li'o/ /skra dang ba spu dag la ni ma hā kaṃ kā la'o/ /pags pa dang dri ma dag la ni kaṃ kā la'o/ sha la ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'o/

/rtsa rgyus la ni su la wai ri'o/ /rus pa la ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /mkhal ma ni rdo rje'i 'od do/ /snying la ni rdo rje'i sku'o/ /mig la ni aṃ ku ri'o/ /mkhris pa la ni rdo rje ral pa can no/ /glo ba la ni dpa' bo chen po'o/ /rgyu ma la ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad do/ /mnye ma la ni rab tu bzang po'o/ /lte ba la ni rdo rje bzang po'o/ /lgang pa la ni 'jigs byed chen po'o/ /'dom bar la ni mig mi bzang ngo / /bad kan la ni stobs po chen po'o/ /rnag la ni rin chen rdo rje'o/ /khrag la ni rta mgrin no/ /rngul la ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /tshigs la ni dpal rdo rje he ru ka'o/ /mchi ma la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /mchil ma la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /snabs la ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /zhes brjod de de dag ni khams rnams lha'i ngo bor dag pa'o/ /khams rnams sngags su dag pa ni 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ so dang sen mo dag la ni oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ skra dang ba spu dag la ni oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ lpags pa dang dri ma dag la ni/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sha la ni oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa rgyus la ni oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rus pa la ni oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mkhal ma la ni oṃ hra hra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying la ni oṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mig dag la ni oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mkhris pa la ni oṃ da ha da ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ glo ba la ni oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyu ma la ni oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru ti ra an+t+ra mā la ya ba laṃ bhi ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mnye ma la ni oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzam ga sarba paṃ pā tardza ya tardza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lto ba la ni oṃ a kaṭa dha a kaṭa dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lgang pa la ni oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'dom bar la ni oṃ dzo ṇoṃ dzo ṇoṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

bad kan la ni oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnag la ni oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khrag la ni oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rngul la ni oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshil la ni oṃ ki li ki li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mchi ma la ni oṃ si li si li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mchil ma la ni oṃ hi li hi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snabs la ni oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /rgyan cha'i dag pa ni/ rgyan drug so so la dmigs nas rtsa sngags re re bzlos pa'am de tsam mi nus na/ rus pa'i rgyan drug ni oṃ na mo bha ga wā ti zhes sogs rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod do/ /yang rgyan drug re re'i steng du go cha'i sngags drug bzlas pa'am/ de tsam ma nus na/ 'khor lo la oṃ hā/ rna rgyan la na ma hi/ mgul rgyan la swā hā huṃ/gdub bu drug la bau ṣaṭa he/ ska rags la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs la phaṭa haṃ zhes brjod/ mgrin pa'i mgul rgyan ni oṃ na mo bha ga te badz+ra wa ra hi zhes sogs yum gyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod do/ /mi mgo lnga bcu tham pa'i do shal ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bhan swā hā/ rna rgyan la oṃ hrīḥhā hā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ glang po che'i pags pa dang stag gi pags pa la ni/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ska rags la ṇi/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi thod pa ni/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ṇī ye badz+ra wār+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba nas brtsams te/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i bar dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags ma yin pa rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun po 'ba' zhig gi sngags rdzogs par 'don no/ /thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/
