ces brjod cing de'i ngo bor dran par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dag pa re zin pa'i rjes kho na la yum rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi dag pa'ang de bzhin yin no snyam du dran par bya zhing / gzhan yang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha'i sku/ shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mtshan mo shes rab rtags par bya/ /zhes brjod cing dran par bya'o/ /gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ zhes sogs nas gnyis su med par gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis yab yum gyi go cha bkod/ pu dza o a nas na si ma ku'i bar ngag tu brjod la/ lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yab yum nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur zhes go cha chen pos bsrung ngo / ༈ /de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa ni/ rang gi srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar haṃ yig 'bar ba brjod/ srin lag de nyid sa la bsnun cing ngag tu/ haṃ haṃ haṃ zhes brjod pas sa g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes smra bar gyur zhes brjod/ de nas de'i mchod pa la dmigs te/ sum bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur zhes pa'i bar dang ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul de bzhin du sngags gzhan 'dra ba las/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

zhes pas zhabs bsil/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ de bzhin du dhū pe/ a lo kā+e/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa byed/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs gong ltar las/ dbang blang bar 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar bris shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mtshan sngags la pād+yaṃ sbyar/ zhes chu gnyis phul la/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas sa la reg te/ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du thim par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas lha sta gon du gnas pa ni/ sa'i lha mo'i sgos mchod dang / me tog dman pa bsal la/ thog mar phur bu btab pa ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du gong du bshams pa'i phur bu 'dus byas la/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dbus kyi phur bu blangs te/ ngag tu/ dbus kyi phur bu gnod mdzes nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnams pa/

smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ sum+bha rā dza badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍal tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / oṃ gha gha nas a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod la/ rang ngam las kyi rdo rjes dbus su gdab tshul byas la gha ta'i sngags kyis gdab par nag po bshad sbyar nas gsungs pas ma chad pa gal che'o/ /bshad sbyar gyi mjug na gzhung 'di shes par 'dod na 'di med thabs mi 'dug go gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /shar gyi phur gdan la btsugs/ shar lho'i phur bu blangs te/ shar lho'i phur bu mi g.yo ba nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ka ni ru ni badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭa dang gha gha sogs brjod cing shar lho'i phur gdan la btsugs/ lho nub kyi phur bu blangs te/ lho nub kyi phur bu dbyug sngon can sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug pa sngon po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ni la daṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭa dang gha gha sogs brjod cing lho nub kyi phur gdan la btsugs/ nub byang gi phur bu blangs te/ nub byang gi phur bu rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ha ya gṛ wa badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭa dang gha gha sogs brjod cing nub byang gi phur gdan la btsugs/ byang shar gyi phur bu blangs te/ byang shar gyi phur bu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnams pa/

smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭa dang gha gha sogs brjod cing byang shar 'di khro bo lnga la ye shes pa spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs byed pa'i zin bris 'dra 'dug na'ang rtog bzo mkhas khyad kha thal kho nar shes par bya'o/ /gyi phur gdan la btsugs/ de nas dbus kyi phur bu blangs la oṃ sum+bha rā dza lan lngar brjod do/ /dang po'i rang ngam las kyi rdo rjes tsan+dan gyi lde'u dbul ba ste dri bzang gi chus las kyi rdo rje'i ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis dri bzang gi chu cung zad 'thor/ gnyis pa me tog gi tshom bu dbul las kyi rdo rjes phur gdan gyi mdun nas 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu re thog ma nas bkod la sngags brjod dus bsam pas chog gsum pa dar dmar gyi cod pan mgul du bcings/ bzhi pas yungs kar gyis phur ma re mgul du gdags phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir cod pan dang yungs kar phur ma sa la thog ma nas bdag la sngags brjod dus bsam pas chog lnga pas gu gul gyi dud pa dbul las kyi rdo rjes bdug de bzhin du phur bu gzhan rnams la'ang rang rang gi sngags tshar lnga lnga bzlas/ tsan+da gyi lde'u dbul ba sogs shes par bya'o/ / rdzas 'di rnams la gzhan gyis rgyas bkab nas puṣ+pe la sogs pa'i sngags so sor brjod pas phyag len byed pa dang yi ger bris pa mthong na yang 'di rje btsun gyi dgongs pa dang 'gal te/ nag po dkyil chog las de dag thams cad la rang rang gi sngags kyis de dag nyid kyi phur pa'i rtsa bar tsan+dan dmar po'i lde'u dbul ba sogs nas/ re re la'ang rang rang gi sngags bzla zhing bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas lha sta gon gyi maṇ+ḍal la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor la/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs der raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas/

oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ ḍaṃ hūm̐ gis bar gyis srung 'khor bsgom/ pū dza nas/ na si ma ku'i bar brjod la/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa rang bzhin gyi lhun gyis grub par gyur ces brjod tshom bu'i 'god sngags gtso bo nas dur khrod bar thams cad la 'bru gsum lan rer brjod/ de nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod la/ ri rab kyi steng srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā sogs nas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar lus dkyil bzhin/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo nas/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i 'phreng bar brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar rten dang brten pa thams cad sgrub thabs ltar cig char bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug go cha bgo dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa rnams mngon rtogs bzhin bya'o/ /mchod pa'i rnam grangs bcu gnyis las dang po sngags mchod ni bdag bskyed bzhin gnyis pa phyi'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bdud rtsi dang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā bdun las thod pa bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bskyed la rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/

stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba wī ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā zhes pas mchod yon dang / de bzhin du tshigs bcad rkang pa tha ma gnyis dang gong ma sngar bzhin las rkang pa gnyis pa'i mchod yon gyi tshab tu zhabs bsil dang ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pād+yaṃ bcug la zhabs bsil dbul/ me tog la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad kyi sbyor tshul de bzhin la sngags oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sngon du 'gro bas yo gi nī badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ dang / badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dī pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shap+ta ā hūm̐/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta la sogs pa brjod cing rol chen rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/ gsum pa na za'i mchod pa ni ras zung bdud rtsi dang / sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i na bza' srab pa 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par bskyed la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sogs dang / oṃ yo gi ni oṃ badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod la lha re re la na bza' zung rer phul bar bsam/ bzhi pa rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las lha mo rnams spros par bsam la/ oṃ wi ni badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥzhes brjod cing / dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma/ sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi waṃ sgra yis mchod/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba wi ra yo gi ni wi ni badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te hūm̐/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ waṃ s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥces dang tshigs bcad rkang pa bar ma gnyis thams cad la 'dra bar byas la/ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi ni waṃ s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te hūm̐/ yang oṃ mṛ taṃ ga badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi ni mṛ taṃ ga badz+rini badz+ri pū tsi ta hūm̐/ oṃ murdzi badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang yo gi ni murdzi badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te hūm̐/ yang / oṃ ha s+ye badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥli khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang yo gi nī ha s+ye badz+ri ni badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ la s+ye badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ /nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang yo gi nī la s+ye badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐/ yang / oṃ gīrti badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ /gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyan pa'i glu yis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī ha s+ye badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ nīrti badz+ra hūm̐ āḥ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī gīrti badz+ri ni badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang /

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog bsil mas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī ha s+ye badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ dhū paṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug spos sprin gyis mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī dī paṃ badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar me'i phreng bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī dī paṃ badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ gan+dhe badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ sin+dhu'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri bzang byug pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī gan+dhaṃ badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ rū pa badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang /yo gi nī rū pa badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ rā sa badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī dhu paṃ badz+ri ni badz+ri pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ par+ṣe badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī puṣ+pe badz+ri ni pū tsi te hūm̐ yang / oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos khams bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / yo gi nī dharmā dhā tu badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te hūm̐/ ces pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/

lnga pa rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las rin chen sna bdun spros te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod par bsam la/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba wī ra yo gi ni tsakra rat+na pū tsi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang tshigs su bcad pa rnams thun mong ba ltar bya zhing sngags 'dis sbrel te shes par bya'o/ /drug pa 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa ji snyed yod pa legs par bsdu na de dag dngos su bshams pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa'i gzugs la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par rnams dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la phul bar mos te/ phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal tu gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni rū pa ka ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū tsi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang tshigs su bcad pa thun mong ba dang sngags 'di bzhin so sor sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /bdun pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod la g.yon du lan gsum bskor la dbul nas blangs te/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par mos la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid kyi mtshan nas brjod de/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pa'i thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de nas/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan slob dpon sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub ri khrod mgon po dang / /lū hi pa dang dha ri ka /an+tar pa dang ti lo pa/ /nā ro ta pa dang pham mthing pa/ /blo gros grags pa rje btsun mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /dkon mchog dpal dang bsod nam dpal/ /blo gros brtan pa dpal ldan pa/ /ye shes rgya mtshan kun dga'i mtshan/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bla ma mchod/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge dang / /dkon mchog blo gros bud+dha'i zhabs/ 'di sangs rgyas rin chen yin/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams mtshan/ /rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs/ /yongs 'dzin dkon mchog dpal ldan dang / /byams pa kun dga' bkra shis dang / /shes rab 'byung gnas dam chos mtshan/ /mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang / ngor chen bkra shis lhun grub zhabs/ /'jam mgon sangs rgyas ye shes sogs/ /rab mchod dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / de nas gong gi sngags mchod ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar gyi sngags brjod pa'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i thig le byas la/ 'bru gsum brjod pas lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bsam/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pas mgon po dang / oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pas gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la dbul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lhar bsam la/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phangs thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dbul zhing de ltar bsam mo/ /brgyad pa mnyes pa'i mchod pa ni/ bdag gi lce la bdud rtsi bzhag ste/ lus dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad dgyes par bsam nas oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lha thams cad kyis zhal nas gsung bar bsam la bdag gis kyang brjod cing rnam lnga 'dod skor byas te mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya snying khar bca' ba'o/

/ thog ma dbus/ de nas g.yas/ yang dbus/ de nas g.yon yang dbus rnams su 'khyud rgya bya/ 'di gong ma'i phyag len 'khrul med yin zhing dgos gnad khyad par can yod do/ /dgu pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ spyi bor nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ mchod pa'i sprin byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba lta bu nam mkha'i khams gang bar mchod par bsam ste ngag tu/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / /ces sogs nas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra nas/ ba le na tsa ye swā hā zhes pa'i bar brjod do/ /bcu pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad dang / chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lhag pa'i lhar gyur pa'i/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces sogs dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog la bstod pa/ rgyal ba sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing / raṃ raṃ rnam 'khor ut+pal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi/ rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas oṃ oṃ dag par ldan/ tshangs dang lha chen khyab 'jug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa hra hra zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pas/ mi yi seṅge dregs pa 'joms mdzad zhabs kyis gnon mdzad cing / a la la yi sgra sgrog bgegs rnams yongs su 'dar bar mdzad/ cang te'u sgra sgrog lha chen khyab 'jug dag gi lpags pa bsnams/ /thugs rje che sprul rab khros dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing / /lak+ṣ+mi gau rī zhabs kyis gnon cing sku gcar rab tu bzhugs/ lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs bde gshegs dbu rgyan can/ /lha rnams kun gyi 'khor gyis 'khor los yongs bskor mdzad pa po/ /hu lu hu lu dziṃ dziṃ traṃ baṃ rgyu ma thod rlon gyi/

/phreng ba 'dzin cing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs shing khro ba yi/ /glu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs mdzad de/ /rdo rje chen po ma ma kīs ni sku lus rnam par brgyan/ /dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyis 'khor lo'i tshogs skrag mdzad/ /ka haṃ ka ha'i bzhad sgras gnod sbyin tshogs rnams skrag cing rengs par mdzad/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing pa pi sha nas sku lus brgyan/ /bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi chad pa'i dus kyis mthar yang ni/ /ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭa kyi mdzad pa can/ /stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phros/ /phyin ci log zhen lta ngan mtha' dag ma lus sel mdzad cing / /gu lu gu lu dzaṃ dzaṃ yaṃ yaṃ gyis ni zhi bar mdzad/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin/ /bde ba chen po khyod ni maṃ maṃ zhes ni mdzad pa can/ /sems can don du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad pa mdzad pa po/ /ā li kā li rab tu sbyor bas sdom pa gsang ba can/ /bcom ldan mkha' 'gro dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yi/ /dpal chen he ru ka ni brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa 'di bsgom phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /lha dang mi rnams gsang ba gsum dag he ru ka yi gzugs 'dzin 'gyur/ ces pa rnams kyis bstod de/ bcu gcig pa ku sha'i mchod pa ni/ ku sha rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa chun po brgyad hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha dkyil 'khor gyi 'bags pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par dmigs la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor gyis dbul bar bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa kha sbyor brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/

ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du kha sbyor brgyad bsam la/ lus kyis 'khyud pa'i steng ka brgyad bya zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes lan brgyad brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad mnyes par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pas mchod nas/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir bdud rtsi ril bu cung zad bsres pa'i spos 'bul ba'i tshul dang med pa rnams rdo rje thugs kar thal mo gyen bstan gyi tshul du bzung la tshigs bcad re la dril gsil bya/ spos dang bcas rdo rje dril bu thogs la dbyangs dang ldan pa'am med kyang rung ste/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig ma'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyod rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag bdag gis ni/ /nang bar dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyid/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyi byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod la/ de nas dril bu rgyun chags dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nas dbang blang bar 'tshal na sang 'dir byon nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyang stsal tu gsol/ zhes dang / rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces brjod cing gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas slob ma sta gon don tshan bcu gnyis bsdus pa ni dkyil dang shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyi mtshams sbyor duchog blta'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa ni/ rgyas par na bum pa zhe drug la sogs pa mang bar gsungs kyang / mdor bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa la sogs pa gnyis su mdzad de de gnyis la'ang mtshan ma gdags/mtshan ma rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa gdags so/

/sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi gdan 'khor lo rim pa lnga dang / las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sogs kyis mngon byang dang po gnyis bskyed nas/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes nyi ma'i steng mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la oṃ āḥhūm̐ yum gyi mkha' dag pa'i ngo bo pad+ma/ yab kyi byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba ye shes sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig rnams steng du brtsegs pa'i oṃ āḥl thim/ zhes sogs sgrub thabs ltar 'dra tshul las bskyed pa'am/ yang na mngon byang gsum pa/ hūm̐ dkar po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bum thod bzhi/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang bcas par gyur pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi bar sta gon bzhin bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i bum par khaṇ+ḍa ro hī sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa skra grol ba gcer bu g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa gsal gdab ye shes pa gzhug go cha bgo

dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams sta gon bzhin las khaṇ+ḍa ro hi la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sogs mtshan sngags re re sngon du 'gro bas/ ar+ghaṃ nas ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ pu dza sogs dang hūm̐ brgyad brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo zhes pas nang mchod/ oṃ hrīḥha ha sogs brjod de bdud rtsi lce la myangs/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs kyis yid mchod/ rol mo dang bcas pa'i rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams bya/ pad bskor dang bcas pas gzungs thag blangs te/ bdag gi snying kha nas sngags rnams kha dog dmar po'i tshul gyis gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas lha so so la phog pas dmar lam lam song ba dang sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun phra la la byung bas bum pa thams cad mer mer gang bar gyur zhes brjod la rnam rgyal la oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs yum gyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyang rnam rgyal du bskyed pas sngags zur du mi dgos nye snying kho na dang / las bum la/ sum+bha ni dang khrus kyi don du a bhi ṣe ka ta rnams brgya rtsa re bzlas la/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyi mthar ma 'byor ba dang sogs dang / bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes dang / pad bskor sngon 'gro'i dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blug ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur ces brjod/ de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul tshul ni oṃ sum+bhal sogs pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bdud rtsi gtor bas bgegs bsangs/

oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs brjod pas stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa lta bu kha dog sngon po yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ā las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ shin tu rgya che ba ās mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su go las ba glang gi sha shar du ku las khyi'i sha /byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las rta'i sha lhor na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang chub kyi sems/ nub tu ma las sha chen no/ /lhor ra las rak+ta/ 'di ni cung zad 'khrul bar snang yang jo bo nā ro tā pa'i gsung yin pas bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len yin gsung ngo / /de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bh+rūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dziṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de dag gi steng gi mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar te/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams 'od du zhu zhing bkol rlang pa'i 'od zer steng du 'phros pas oṃ dang sna tshogs zla ba rdo rjes yang bskul te/ de dag las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag par bsam/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer steng du 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/

mdun gyi thod pa la thod pa thim/ bdud rtsi la bdud rtsi thim ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa ltung bas gnyis su med par gyur nas kha dog dang dri dang ro dang / nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum bzlas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad la phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa cha brgyad du gyur/ yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sngags skyes zhing skyes lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor thams cad phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dkyil 'khor cha dgu la thim/ oṃ yo ga zhes sogs brjod cing rnam lnga 'dod skor byas te brtan par bya'o/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ la rdo rje sbu gu can hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam zhing / gtor ma las thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba du ma chad de/ thams cad kyi phyag tu bzhag pas gsol bar bsam zhing / lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye la ngag tu oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ trī sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan lnga brjod pas 'khor lo dgu tshan lnga rim pa bzhin tshim par bsam ste/ oṃ ka ra ka ra la sogs 'phreng sngags bzlas pas kyang mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo ste phyi mchod/ sa bon so so'i mthar 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod/ na mo sogs yid mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod nas/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom/ /khyed kyi dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ /mgon po thugs rje'i char gyi yang dag brlan pa'i thugs kyi chus/ /lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/

/de nas yi dam chos skyong sogs gzhan 'bul dgos rnams gtor chog so so nas 'byung ba ltar skabs dang sbyar la dbul/ sta gon gyi rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ nas gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ oṃ hrīḥha ha 'dir yang 'bru gsum brjod la bdud rtsi myangs te sogs/ mkhyud rgya dang / a nu rā ga sogs kyis mnyes mchod/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs sngags dang bcas pas yid mchod/ rol mo dang bcas pas rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog te/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs par bsam la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar brtan par bzhugs nas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol zhes brjod de nas rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs dang /

badz+ra muḥye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ oṃ ha dkar po sogs dpa' bo'i go cha dang dpa' mo'i go cha gong bzhin dang / go cha chen po ni pū dza sogs nas ma ku'i bar ngag tu brjod/ tsham ngam sngags kyis bsrung ba ni gong srung 'khor skabs bzhin/ lag g.yon sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur ston cing / ngag tu oṃ sum+bha sogs tshar gnyis brjod dus sems kyis phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar ser 'bar ba'o/ /steng 'og g.yon g.yas bsnol mar bya dga' ba gsum dran pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku'i rnam pa/ oṃ na mo nas dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa bar gyi yab kyi rkang brgyad tshar gcig brjod la/ brjod pa dang grag pa'i sgra thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs dang / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zhes brjod/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs tshang ma gzhan yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bkra shis gang shes bya'o/ /sta gon thams cad bstan zin to/ ༈ /dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa gsum pa thig gis bri ba la gnyis las/ dang po la thig gi cha dbye ba ni gzhung nas bshad pa ltar bya'o/ gsal byed kun mkhyen gung ru'i thig rtsa bzhin/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi mdun du thig tshon rnams 'dus byas la/

rdo rje'i rtses dbus su sngon po la hūm̐/ shar du dkar po la bh+rūṃ/ lhor ser po la āṃ/ nub tu dmar po la dz+riṃ/ byang du ljang khu la khaṃ rnams bris pa'i tshon so so'i nang du kha dog dang mthun pa'i srad bu'ang bzhag de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / gtor ma gcig dang / nang mchod rnams bshams nas/ rang lha'i nga rgyal du gnas pas thig tshon rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dkar po bh+rūm̐ las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ser po āṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dmar po dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med he ru sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ljang khu khaṃ las don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa de rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa nas tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog go /zhes pa yab kyi go cha bkod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbastim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca ku la ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod/ bh+rūṃ āṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /'khor ba stong par mdzad pa'i thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la dgod mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur par bsam nas/ oṃ badz+ra su tra sa ma ya ma ti kra hoḥ zhes yum gyi nye snying / sarba bud+dha sogs dang / rtsa sngags gnyis med rnams ci rigs brjod cing bla ma'i mtheb srin gyis rdul tshon mnye la/ thig tshon gzi brjid 'bar bar bsams/ tshon gtso bo lnga po de nas/ mtheb srin gyis so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshon gzhan rnams la'ang cung zad re blug par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma mkha' 'gro ma'am/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hir bsam la thig skud rnams so sor brkyangs la sgril bar bya ste/ yum gyi nye snying lan mang du bzlas/ rtsa sngags gnyis su med pa yang bzlas shing / thig skud rnams phyogs gcig tu sgril zin pa dang / rdo rje la dkris la bdud rtsi gtor zhing byin gyis brlabs/ ye thig gdab pa dngos ni dkyil chog bzhin gdab dgos pas/ de nas ji ltar gdab pa'i thabs ni/ bla mas rnal 'byor pa'i shar te 'jig rten pa'i lhor bsdad la/ slob ma rnal 'byor pa'i nub ste 'jig rten pa'i byang du gnas la dzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod de thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzaḥdzaḥbarjod cing blangs la/ bla ma'i thig skud dkyil 'khor nas lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ steng nas bcus te blangs la 'og nas yar la btab pas thig skud kyi sgra las/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don mdzod cig ces 'byung bar yang bsams/ ngag tu yang brjod la bar snang la thig rjes bsam mo/ /ye thig skor phyogs rtogs sla ba'i phyir sdoms su byas na/ lho byang nub shar rgyab 'gros kyis/ /tshangs thig gnyis ni gdab bya zhing / /me rlung srin dbang rgyab 'gros kyis/

/zur thig gnyis ni gdab par bya/ /me dbang me srin shar dang lho/ rlung srin rlung dbang nub dang byang / /rgyab 'gros spangs te g.yon phyogs su/ /bskor ba thig rjes g.yas skor 'byung / /nyis 'debs dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob mar shes par bya/ /bla ma dbang ldan mi 'gro zhing / /slob ma me yi mtshams mi 'gro/ /phyogs mtshams ngos 'dzin 'jig rten dang / /mthun par me thig 'khrul med gdab/ /ces pa ltar shes par byas la/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo 'jig rten pa'i lho dang / slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi nub ste 'jig rten pa'i byang du gnas pas thig skud slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la dkri'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥzhes brjod cing ye thig nam mkhar bteg la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin nas shar sgor bltas la/ gar skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu dkur bzung la smin ma gcus te dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi la bltas la hi hi zhes brjod pas sgo bzhi phye bar bsam/ srin lag gnyis kyi dri bzang gi chus sgo bzhi'i rtsa thig dbye la/ ngag tu/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa rnams dbye bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod thig gis bri ba rnams bstan zin to/ /dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bzhi pa tshon gyis bri ba ni/ gzhi chen ser po ste ngo bo la sngon por kho nar spyod/ yang kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir ser po byas na mdzes gsung yang lcags nag shin tu nag pas gzhi tshon byas pa legs shing kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon mi yong ba'i dgongs pa'ang grub pa yin no/ /bla ma dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bri ba'i dus su yang 'di skad du/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams rnams sgrol byed pa/

/dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsams/ /zhes brjod cing bri bar bya'o/ /de nas yid kyis mchod pa lnga phul la/ ting la sogs pas kha bcad de rdo rje la ye shes kyi thig skud dkris pas steng nas mnan la phyis de'i mtshams su sleb sleb tu kha mi phye bar bzhag phur khung tshon gyis dgang ba ni/ nang gi 'og tu dkar po/ de nas ser po/ de nas dmar po/ de nas ljang khu/ de nas sngon pos dgang ngo / de ni dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyi dril tshul rgyas par ni 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i nag po lugs kyi dkyil 'khor bri tshul bzhin no/ /de ltar bris zin pa dang thig tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod pa mdor bsdus phul la/ ye shes pa rnams sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar thim/ zhes dang / nam mkhar btegs pa'i ye shes kyi thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa'o/ /de ni rgyan dgram pa'i thog mar bum pa dbul ba ni/ spos dang rol mo sngon du 'gro bas/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa dang las kyi rdo rje las bum bzung la/ dkyil 'khor la g.yon phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum byas te yig brgya brjod/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lha rnams la bum pa 'bul ba'i tshul byas la/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod la shar sgo'i g.yon phyogs su bum gdan gyi steng du bzhag yang slob dpon gyis las bum bzung la/ sum+bha ni bzla zhing lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas pa'i mthar/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod la shar sgo'i g.yas phyogs su bzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog la sogs pa'i spyi mchod dang sgos mchod ni ji tsam 'byor pa spyi mdzes su bkod/

gzhan yang slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod la sogs pa dang / gos zung ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ ting lo/ chang bu gtor ma rnams gsum gsum/ til/ gu gul/ me long / sku phyis/ yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma sogs phyag len bzhin bshams/ slob ma dbang bskur dgos na de'i yo byad dkyil chog bzhin dang gong du bshad pa'i mtshams sbyor/ gnas yo byin rlabs gnyis sta gon bzhin la/ ma tshang pa med par 'dus byas la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed rigs bdag gtso 'khor thams cad la/ rgyas 'deb yan sgrub thabs bzhin la/ mchod pa'i nag po dkyil chog las bdag nyid la tshes bcu'i dus bzhin mchod pa ci 'grub bya bar gsung ba bzhin 'di tsam cis kyang ma chad par gal che'o/ /skabs su sngags mchod dang / phyi mchod kyi rjes su rig ma bcu drug rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga rnams tshigs bcad dor la sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ de'i rjes su nang mchod nas brtsams te go cha gsum gyis bsrung ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ sngar phur pa rnams zin bris la lar phur bu bsdu ba'i dus mchod bstod ye shes pa gshegs gsol la sogs bshad pa ni zo ran la nas nyes par gda' bas rje btsun gyi dgongs pa bzhin mdzad na mi dgos so/ /sdod dgos byung na skabs 'dir sta gon bzhin phur gdan tshul bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sbyang ba'i chas rnams dkyil 'khor dang nye bar phyag len bzhin bshams te/ gtor ma gsum chab kyis bran la las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs su gtor ma skor ba dang bstun te/ dpon slob rnams kyis lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang oṃ sarba bhigh+naṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs brjod/ sngags rdzogs pa dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ de lta bu zhi bas sbyang ba dang lan gsum byed/ de bzhin du ting lo dang chang bus bskor ba dang bstun la rdo rje gsor/

sum+bha ni brjod pa lan zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang gsum byas la/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po/ bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod bstod mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len slob ma yod na slob ma la 'jug cing sogs skabs dang sbyar ro/ /pa sogs la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log pa 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ sum+bha ni bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab bo/ / drag po'i sbyang ba la khro bo'i spyan mchod bstod sogs gzhan nas rgyas mi 'geb 'di tsam gyi don tshang zhing nag po dkyil chog gi dgos pa'ang 'grub bo/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ las kyi rdo rjes g.yas phyogs su me dang g.yon du chu/ de gnyis kyi bar du til bzhag la ngag tu bdag gi snying ga nas tshe thog ma med pa las kyi sdig pa rnams yi ge kaṃ gi rnam par byung nas/ sna sgo sdigs pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ zhes dang las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb srin gyis til blangs la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ka kha kha khā hi khā hī sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum brjod nas/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /ces brjod la til de nyid g.yas su mer bsreg g.yon du chur blug la de nas me de yang g.yon gyi chur blug la phyir dor ro/

/khrus kyi don du las kyi rdo rjes las bum me long sku phyis rnams bzung la/ dpon slob rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs brjod cing me long la dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor bri mkhan gyi mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad bkru'o/ /de nas/ de dag sku la 'di phal cher ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi phyag len ltar bkod pa yin/ sogs dang / oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā ka ya bi shwo dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing sku phyi tshul bya'o/ /nag po dkyil chog tu sku phyi ba'i tshig dngos su ma bshad kyang / mkha' 'gro lnga'i sa bon brjod cing me long la dri'i thig le lnga byed par gsungs pa ni/ sku phyi la sa bon 'dir slob dpon rang nyid gdong bkru bar bshad pa dang ma bshad pa mang du snang yang phyag len la mi mdzad 'dug pa ni/ nag po bshad sbyar du/ gdong ni dag par bkru bar bya/ zhes bya bas sgrub pa po bdag rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil chog gi sdig pa sbyangs skabs bdag dang slob ma gnyis kyi sdig pa sbyangs/ zhes til gyis sbyangs pas don tshang bar snang ngo / /dri'i thig le lnga byed par gong du bshad pas don 'dra bar snang zhing / de dag sku la sogs kyi tshig kyang dgos par thon no/ /sbyangs khrus byed dgos rnams dngos gzhi byung tshad la bri ba dang rgyan dgram pa bstan zin to/ ༈ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa lnga pa bskyed cing byin rlabs pa la/ dang po bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ sum+bha ni sogs 'dus pas bsang ba mi dgos so/ /swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes pa nas lha thams cad bsang ba ni bgegs sbyang ba rgyas pa sogs ma thag yin pas/ kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/

/zhes pa'i bar sta gon bzhin la/ khyad par tshom bu'i dgod sngags dor la/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel ma byed na/ dngos gzhi nyi ma dang po la ye shes pa gzhug pa'i sngon du sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar btegs pa de la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sogs lan gcig sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs yid mchod kyis mchod la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs sta gon bzhin bya'o/ /lha rnams byin gyis brlabs pa drug skor la/ las kyi rdo rjes dbyug pa gzungs thag btags la bzung ste lha gang byin gyis rlobs pa'i gnas der rdo rjes rtse mos reg cing / slob dpon gyis de'i gzungs thag nas bzung ba'ang / yang na slob dpon nyid kyis phyag gi rdo rjes lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa bdun/ thod pa bzhi rnams la phyogs g.yon bskor mtshams g.yas skor gyis reg te/ dang po rang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la/ gtso bo yab yum la snying po gnyis ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni sogs brjod/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes zhal bzhi pa dang so so'i sngags spel nas brjod/ thod pa bzhi la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bzhi/ thugs 'khor rnams la/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs dang gsung 'khor rnams la/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e ra wa ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs dang / sku 'khor ba rnams la/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ oṃ na mo bhā ga wa te wi ri sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes yab kyi rkang brgyad dang so so'i sngags spel nas brjod/ gnyis pa/

oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar te yum gyi nye snying dang / gsum pa oṃ kā kā s+ye/ u lu kā s+ye/ shwa na s+ye/ su ka ra s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags dang / bzhi pa a āḥnas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ā li dang / lnga pa/ oṃ ka kha ga gha nga nas/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces kā li dang / drug pa oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs nas brtan par byas la/ mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i dgos pa ni/ dang po chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du shes pa'i phyir lha dang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa lha so so'i rnam pa de yang chos sku skye ba med pa'i rnam 'phrul du rtogs par bya ba'i phyi+er yum gyi nye snying gis byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pa chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nas 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i don du sgo ma bzhi'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ bzhi pas 'phrin las bzhi po de yang thabs snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba dgos pa'i ched du ā lis byin gyis brlabs/ lnga pas thabs snying rje chen po de yang shes rab kyis zin pa zhig dgos zhes mtshon pa'i phyir kā lis byin gyis brlabs/ drug pa ni de dag thams cad brtan par bya phyir yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /de dag gis ni bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa bstan zin to/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa drug pa mchod pa ni/ sngags mchod nas brtsams te kha sbyor brgyad kyi mchod pa'i bar sta gon bzhin bya ba ste mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar gsungs kyang phyag len la bdag 'jug gi rjes la mdzad do/

/sgrub mchod zhag sbrel nas byed na/ dngos gzhi dang po bum bskyed sta gon gyi dgongs sgrub zin pas mi dgos/ gnyis pa man chod la skabs 'dir bum bskyed mdzad/ ༈ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun pa 'jug pa la slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang / slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa la'ang phyi'i 'jug pa dang / nang 'jug gnyis kyi dang po la bdun las/ dang po yon dbul ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal/ bum pa/ dbu rgyan/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs/ rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan dbang rdzas rnams yid kyis bsams/ de nas las bum gyi chus gdong bkru ba'am cung zad cig bzung la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul dus/ dang po dang tha ma la tshig rgyas pa brjod cing / gzhan rnams la/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba 'debs pa nag po dkyil chog nas ma bshad pas mi mdzad do/ /sogs kyis dbul/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ nas/ kun gyi dri med mthong bar shog sogs dkyil chog bzhin lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa gdong bcing ba ni/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gdong dar bcings tshul dang / bzhi pa me tog 'phreng ba gtad pa ni/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ me tog nas 'bras gang rung lag tu blangs/ ku shas las bum gyi chu rang la gtor zhing / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hī dpag tu med par spros te bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang /

log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ lnga pa dri zhing lan gdab pa ni/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris pa'i lan gdab par mos la skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes pa lan gcig brjod/ dkyil chog las dri ba lan gsum gsum kyang phyag len la tshar gcig mdzad do/ /drug pa nang gi sems bskyed pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje bzung la/ rang gi snying kha'i nang du rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa shin tu 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa gsang ba gdams shing nang du gzhug pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod lag pa gnyis thal mo'i bar du rdo rje bzung dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo dud pa dang bcas pas ngag tu/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes pa de tsam gyis ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang du 'jug pa la bcu bzhi'i nag po bshad sbyar gyi dgongs pa ltar lags/ dang po dkyil 'khor tshig bsgrag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos zhal nas gsungs par bsam la/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes brjod gnyis pa lhar bskyed cing go cha bcings pa la thog mar nang gi bar chad bsrung ba ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang / bdud rtsi lcer myangs shing lus la'ang gtor/ lhar bskyed cing go cha bcing ba dngos ni/ rang skad cig gis pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du sogs go cha gnyis bkod/

gsum pa dpa' bo bskul ba ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor te/ ngag tu/ phaiṃ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod/ rang gi mthe bong g.yas pa gtso bo'i phyag g.yon pas bzung phyag g.yas pas ḍā ma ru dkrol bar bsam la ḍā ma ru dkrol oṃ shrī he ru ka a bhirma he bid+yā rā dzaḥ.a dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing / rang gi sems nyid la dpa' bo bskul bar bsam pa'o/ /bzhi pa phyag dang skyabs 'gro gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seṅge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid bdag la grub par mdzod/ kyi bar sbrel te lan gsum dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi sogs lan gsum brjod/ lnga pa sbyang bar bya ba ni/ gong bzhin sbyang ba gsum byed/ de tsam mi nus na bgegs phyag len la bdag 'jug gi tshe bgegs sbyang ba las mi mdzad sbyang ba tsam byas kyang rung ngo / /drug pa nang du 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi lhar bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo zhes sogs bum bskyed bzhin brjod la/

mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes ba'i bar sta gon bzhin brjod/ bsdu na skad cig gis bskyed kyang rung / rang gi snying khar rtsa 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi hūm̐ yig bcom ldan 'das nang gi he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sogs gtso bo yab yum dang / nang bskor rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir mdun nas brtsams te g.yon bskor du laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ las shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya sogs kyi lha mo bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi la sangs rgyas kyis gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad la shar du kha gdong ma sngo skya sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad skyed zhal phyag rnams sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /phyi nang gi lha de rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang yum gyi gnas su yab yum gnyis su med par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis go cha gnyis bkod/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang / phaiṃ snying kha'i gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs kyi rang bzhin yi ge ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs rang gi snying khar thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad khyab te zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang bar gyur/ /ces brjod/ de tsam gyis lha dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa'o/ /bdun pa phyag bya ba ni/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar la/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥme hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang spros pa la dga' na/ sgo bzhi nas kyang phyag bya ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas mkha' 'gro mas bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la ngag tu/

oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi ni pū dzo sas+d+ya na ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya tā ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ro yo gi ni at+ma ḍā ki nī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ de nas byang sgo nas mā mas bdag la dbang skur cig snyam pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ ngag tu/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī pu dzo a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+ma nir+ya tā ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta nī ra yo gi ni āt+ma lā ma a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ nub sgor khaṇ+ḍa ro his chos kyi 'khor lo skor cig snyam pas thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ ngag tu oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi ni pu dzo dharma tsakra pra warta na ya āt+ma nas/ at+ma khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dharma tsakra pra warta na ya maṃ/ lho sgor gzugs can mas 'phrin las mdzod cig snyam pas thal mo spyi gtsug tu sbyar la/ ngag tu oṃ nas pu dzo karma ne āt+ma nas/ āt+ma ru pi ni karma ku ru maṃ/ brgyad pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ 'di'i lugs kyi sdom pa bsgrag pa tsam gyis kyang thob par bzhed pas thog mar bsgrag pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems dang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/

zhes tshar gcig brjod/ de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sras kyai rdor bzhin gyis chog 'di'i rjes la khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs mdzad pa'i 'phags pa sogs kyi zin bris 'dug kyang nag po dkyil chog dang bshad sbyar gnyis ka las bshad 'dug pas re zhig brtag par bya'o/ /bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs lan gsum brjod/ dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa'i bar gyi phan yon gyi sgo nas dang / yang rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /sogs nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang / bdud rtsi blud de/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshis srung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ sogs brjod cing bdud rtsi 'thung ba gnyis ka'i sgo nas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag te/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig khyod kyis mi bde ba ma spangs pa dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ sogs kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o/ /bcu pa nang gi 'jug pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/

maṇ+ḍal phul te phyag len la kha bskang nas mdzad/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bcu gcig pa ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya ba ni/ rang 'khor lo phyag len la gzhung gong 'og cung zad bsgyur ba 'di bzhin mdzad/ bde mchog tu gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu gdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu re re sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ mgrin par waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum 'byung bzhi bskyed tshul 'di gong gi sgrub thabs dang mthun par byas pa yin no/ /pas mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor la has mtshan pa/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ phul/ des sum mdo'i me 'bar/ des snying kha'i sa sros/ des mgrin pa'i chu bkol/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun snying kha'i sa la thim pas lus la bde drod dpag tu med pa skyes/ de'i dus su rkang mthil gyi rlung dang mes nam mkha' la btegs/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mar phul bas lus bar snang la 'dar yed yed gnas pa la/ nam mkha' nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de yang lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams dmar po'i rnam par thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams dkar po'i snam pas thim zhing / de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba spu'i bu ga nas thim par bsam zhing / rol mo dang rdzas kyis bdug cing / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang /

oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī sogs yab yum gyi snying po gnyis kyi mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a bit+ma he bid+yā rā dza a dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes brjod bdag 'jug la sbogs chog mi mdzad/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod la spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing brtan par bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba bdag 'jug la dngos su mi mdzad/ bcu gsum pa me tog dor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha sum cu rtsa bdun la gtso bo dang 'khor la sogs pa'i bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ma byed cig thams cad kyang dag pa'i ye shes gcig gi snang ba yin la/ rang gi rigs dang rjes su mthun pa la me tog phog pa yin no/ /zhes bsgo bar bsam nas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod la ltos med du dor bar bsam/ me tog bcing ba ni/ rang gi me tog phul ba de gtso bo bla mas slar blangs te/ rang gi mgo bor bcings par bsam la/ pra ti gṛh+na swa mi lam sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ sogs brjod/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub kun khyod dbang bskur 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /sogs dang / sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs/ /gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /spyod dang grol ba rab stsol ba/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/

/zhes pa'i bar sbrel te lan gcig brjod la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod cing bsam/ de tsam gyis ni slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni dkyil chog blta'o/ dang gong du bshad pa'i mtshams sbyor du dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun pa bstan zin to/ /de nas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /ces pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab dpa' bo chen po sogs 'dir mi mdzad/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi skur gyur/ zhes brjod/ yungs kar gyis brdeg cing / sum+bha ni bzlas/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa btegs te rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bkra shis gang sh+lau ka gcig brjod zhig chos kyi sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal zhing bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'dor ro/ /spyi don gsum pa brtul zhugs kyi rim pa la bcu bzhir gnas pa las/ dang po me tog 'phreng ba'am sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ nag po bshad sbyar na ting nge 'dzin gyi dbu la phul bar bsam mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/'dir oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod pa'i zin bris 'ga' zhig snang mod/ phyag len la mi mdzad de/

don gyi bzlas lung yin la 'jug pa'i dus kyi me tog dbul ba lta bu ni ma yin no/ /zin bris pa rnams ni sngar lha la phog pas lha la phul gsung ba la 'khrul par zad do/ /'di'i don nag po bshad sbyar la zhib tu gzigs pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi phreng ba brgyud zhal nas 'thon te rang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra hai sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī sogs gsum gsum bzlas me tog dor ro/ /bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshar gcig brjod/ slar me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar bla mas byin gyis brlabs bdag gi spyi bor bzhag par bsams te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs par bsam zhing brjod/ rigs lnga yab yum du byed pa ni nag po bshad sbyar/ slob ma gnyis med sbyor ldan zhes bya ba ni/ chu'i dbang la sogs pa'i bye brag gis mi bskyod pa la sogs pa yab yum gyi lha'i nga rgyal 'dzin du 'jug pa'o/ /'dis ni he ru ka yab yum du slob ma bskyed pa gsal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas na nag po dkyil chog tu mi gsal ba rnams bshad sbyar du gsal bar mdzad pa yin pas/ rje btsun gyi dgongs pa'ang rigs lnga yum can yin par sems so/ ngor na nag po dkyil chog bzhin yum med phyag len la yod/ /'di sa lo'i phyag len dpal sa skya'i bde chen gling pa'i lugs so/ /des na cho ga'i rnam bzhag ni 'di ltar 'byung ste/ gnyis pa mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi rnam shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pa'i rdo rje dang /

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur zhes dang / rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ khyod rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon te bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ kā kā s+ye/ u lū kā s+ye/ shwa nā s+ye/ sū ka rā s+ye/ ya mā dā dhi ye/ ya ma dū tī ye/ ya ma dam ṣ+ṭi nī ye/ ya ma ma tha nī ye/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bum chu khyor bar blugs te 'thung / bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ bsam pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes nang gi dbang ngo / /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de lta na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa dang /

bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas rin po che dang / g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang du yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur zhes dang / khyod rnams kyis sogs kyis gsol ba btab de nas/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'i/ rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /dar dpyangs dbu rgyan sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs yum gyi nye snying dang / oṃ pra tīts+tsha ma hā mu ku ṭa heḥ zhes brjod cing dbu brgyan dang dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings/ kā kā sogs sngags rnams gong bzhin brjod la ku sha'i rtsa bas bum chu spyi bor gtor la chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba nas thim pas/ lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes nang gi dbang ngo / /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang ni/ swa bhā wa dang / bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te sogs dang dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med he ru ka sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa'i pad+ma dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang du yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur zhes dang khyod rnams kyis sogs gsol ba btab/ de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje longs/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha wī ra sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin/ gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'od dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi mgrin par pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte ba nas zhugs pas lus thams cad 'od dpag tu med pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur zhes nang gi dbang ngo / /mchod pa lngas mchod/ de lta na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag tu med pa dang skal bar mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang ni/ swa bhā wa dang / bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te sogs dang / khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas ral gri dang /

g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang du yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur zhes dang khyod rnams kyis sogs gsol ba btab/ de nas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyings kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /zhes brjod la dril bu lag pa g.yon par byin/ gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis don yod grub pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba nas thim pas lus thams cad don yod grub pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes nang gi dbang ngo / /mchod pa lngas mchod/ de lta na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas/ dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /drug pa rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ni/ swa bhā wa dang / bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te sogs dang / bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas 'khor lo dang / g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i sogs 'dra/ de'i pang na yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ khyod rnams kyis sogs gsol ba btab/ de nas lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi shrī he ru ka na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/

dpal de nas gong bzhin chu dbang bskur rang rang gi gsang mtshan brjod che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing thugs ka nas spros pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis ming 'dogs par bsam pa'o/ /bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rnams par snang mdzad dpag tu med par spyan drangs la/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ mgo thur bltas bsgom pa'i bu ga nas thim pas lus thams cad rnam par snang mdzad rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes nang dbang ngo / /mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no/ /bdun pa brtul zhugs la gnyis las/ dang po rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir thun mong gi brtul zhugs ni/ swa bhā wa dang / rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang skad cig gis mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na sogs mi bskyod pa chu dbang bzhin byed/ rang gi thugs kar yang mi bskyod pa de 'dra ba gcig gis rgyas btab par gyur/ zhes nang dbang gi dod yin no/ /de nas/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwoṃ dha ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs la gnas par gyis shig zhes brjod la lag tu rdo rje gtad pa ni rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ /gnyis pa spyod pa la nus pa mthu dang ldan pa bya ba'i phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs byin pa ni/

swa bhā wa dang / rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i snying khar yang sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyis rgyas gdab par gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yas pa ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa thod pa/ se ral khar tshangs skud/ g.yon pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga byin par bsam la/ 'di la g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin tshul byed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru/ /he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu gsil gsil sgra sgrogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyis sgra sgrog pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyi sems thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin pas na de ltar shes par gyis la sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod pa ste rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ngo / /brgyad pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams/ de nas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas sogs nas/ sa ma ya satwaṃ gyi bar brjod/ rdo rje gsor nas mthar snying khar bzung te thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/
