/rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /rdo rje 'di ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ rig stong dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ rang gi sems rnam par dag pa yang rig stong dbyer med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas dril bu gsung gi dam tshig ni/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni ltag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces brjod dril bu dkrol la mthar dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /dril bu 'di ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba grag stong dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la rang gi ngag rnam par dag pa yang grag stong dbyer med pa dril bu'i sgra ltar shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur zhes brjod rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas te/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /bzung zhing rdo rje byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /rang nyid lha'i sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa gsal la ma 'gags pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shigaces brjod gong bzhin ku sha'i rtsa bas dngos su bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing /

ting 'dzin gyis sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis dbang bskur bar bsam la/ ngag tu/ oṃ kā kā s+ye sogs nas oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan pa la lha thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa yin no/ /oṃ su pra tīṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā zhes brjod cing me tog gtor de nas puṣ+pe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bzhed pa yin/ /sems can rnams ni rjes bzung phyir/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /zhes dang / deng phyin chad khyod rnams rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ /dkyil 'khor dang 'di tshigs bcad kyi gong du bshad kyang phyag len la gong 'og cud bsgyur te mdzad pa yin no/ /lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang rab gnas la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las thams cad sgrub par gyis shig ces bsgo bar bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod pa ste rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /dgu pa rjes gnang ni thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i phyir nang gi lha mo brgyad kyis dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i tshul du bya ba ste so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang / /shes rab thabs bcas snyems can gyi/ /gar mchod bde ba'i mchod par gyis/ /a/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor pa/ /deng nas 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /'phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/

/lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blangs par gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dag /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /ghi/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyi ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ hoḥ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ bh+rūṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyi ni tshim par gyis/ āḥ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldong rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar bgyi/ pra/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ gha/ zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ de ltar na khyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi drung du sgeg pa la sogs pa'i spyod pas dkyil 'khor la mchod pas/ deng phyir chad lta bu'i spyod pa ci byas pa thams cad lha mchod par gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rjes mig gi thad sor byug pa'i tshul du bya zhing / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib gsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis gsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra ya a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod me long la bltar bcug par bsam ste/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyogs pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med gyis/

/'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ chos thams cad snang rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo gong du bshad kyang 'dir mdzad/ la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis la sems can thams cad kyi don gyis shig ces brjod de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas par dung / g.yon par dril bu lag pa gnyis kyi bar du rgyud kyi bshad pa'i po ti sbyin par bsam la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten du ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /ces brjod/ 'dir nag po bshad sbyar las/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang bar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dir/ sems can kun la thams cad du nas/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /ces pa'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa kyai rdor bzhin dang / de ltar sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo nas/ sgra sgrogs bshad par gyis shig ces ji ltar brjod/ de nas 'phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang snod sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ zhes brjod de/ de dag gis ni rjes gnang ngo / /bcu pa dam tshig ni/ thog mar dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin par bya ste/ nang par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang / /bsrung dang bza' la sogs pa yi/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can srung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrungs/

/nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med la gnas pa/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mang po'i tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med dpang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spangs/ /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan mar 'gom par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag gi ma khyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pas/ /bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung / /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod la don dran par bya'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs 'dir mi mdzad pa dbang bzhi rdzogs nas mdzad pa phyag len no/ /spyod pa dang thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pa'i/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag gnas la/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brtas/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa/ /dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa yin/

/sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing / /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /khro ba med pa'i rgyun bcas pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni yongs su srungs/ /rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun la ni rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis med sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid pa/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cing / /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsam nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /zhes brjod la don dran par bya'o/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig dngos ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'di la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ /shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ bde ba chen po thig le la chags pa ste/ chags pa 'di bzhi dang bral ba las khams gsum na sdig che ba med pas/ khyod kyis de dag dang bral bar mi bya zhing / de dag la bslab par byos shig ces brjod/ bcu gcig pa lung bstan cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ bla mas chos gos gyon la g.yon pas chos gos kyi mtha' snying khar bzung g.yas rdo rje dril bu bcas/ skyabs sbyin rang gi spyi bor gtugs par bsam la/ he g.yas rdor dril lhan cig dang g.yon rngul gzan sogs la seṅge'i rna ba ltar bzos la/ ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu 'grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams la ston/ /zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ kyai dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa 'og

sa steng / sa bla rnams he badz+ra aṃ gu ri shrī he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur bhu ba swa/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba thams cad kyis lung ston par mdzad do/ /zhes brjod de ni ma 'ongs pa lung ston pa dang / da lta ba dga' ba bskyed pa ni gzengs bstod pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa na/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu bzhugs pa yin/ /der ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyod rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang de bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod la don yang dran par bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te sogs 'dir mi mdzad/ de ltar na skyed pa ras bris kyi sogs skabs dang sbyar/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bo'i lus kyi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig gi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba dang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / /'bras bu sprul 'di kha skongs pa'i sku bsgrub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /bcu gsum pa gsang dbang ni/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhes pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /ces pas gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing 'og tu bshad kyang 'dir mdzad/

gdong ras bcings tshul bya/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ā las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ ze'u 'bru la ā dang bu gar dh+yaṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ dang bu gar byaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi dpral bar oṃ na mo na mo bhā ga wa te wī ri shā ya nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brjod pa yab kyi rtsa sngags/ yab kyi dpral bar oṃ na mo bhā ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hi nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā'i bar brjod pa yum gyi rtsa sngags/ yum gyi mgrin par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / yab kyi mgrin par oṃ badz+ra bai ro sogs snying po gnyis dang / yum gyi snying khar oṃ hrī ha ha sogs dang / yab kyi snying khar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye sogs nye snying gnyis brjod/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags rnams sbrul 'khyil ba ltar g.yon skor du 'khod par gyur zhes brjod cing bsam/ yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swa ser po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ bla ma he ru 'di yang bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba de nyid/ rang 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i lce thog tu bzhag ces brjod cing bsam la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gi ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni byang chub sgrub rnal 'byor/

/khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag mgrin par myangs pas yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtog pa rags rim 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol bar bsam ste 'bru gsum brjod/ de lta na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs shing mthong / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa la sa bon skyon med btab pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang / lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / rlung gi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sgrub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa gdong 'dir mdzod/ bcing ba rnams gsang dbang bzhin byas la de nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig sprul te rang gi lag pa g.yas par phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yon pa gtad/ bla ma nyid kyis phyag rang gi mgo bor bzhag par bsam ste/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zungs shig zungs shig sems dpa' che/ /bzung la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor/ /khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal rtag sbyor bas/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs tha ma dag spyod cing / /pad+ma'i bha gar tsum+bha dang / /bdud rtsi rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med kun/

/gus dang bcas pa'i mchod pa dang / /gnyis med tshul gyis tsum+bha na/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam/ /smros shig dpa' bo bde ba che/ /bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen brten pa bu spro 'am/ /ci gsungs dam tshig brten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ /ces dri ba dris lan rnams don dran bzhin pas brjod la/ rang dang phyag rgya 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' sogs nas brla gnyis la ha ljang khu zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod la/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pas/ thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba la sogs pa'i chos drug nyams su blangs pas rnam pa sna tshogs pa la dga' ba'i ye shes tsum+bha dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa'i rnam par smin pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ bo la dang kak+ko la sbyar bas rnam par nyed pa la dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ srub cing srub pa'i sbyor ba la brten nas mtshan nyid dang bral ba la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar rdo rje dang pad+ma kha cher srub pas/ 'dod chags chen pos mes lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad nas so so'i byang sems dkar dmar gnyis g.yos te/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo mthar thug pa byang sems dkar po dang / yum gyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor byang sems dmar po byon pa gnyis zhal sbyar bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis byang sems dkar dmar gnyis phyir ba thag tsam yang ma 'dzag par byas par bsam la/ yar drangs nas so so'i lte bar slebs pas dga' ba/ snying khar slebs pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par slebs pas dga' bral/

spyi bor slebs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de ltar na lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab ste/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /de nas 'bru gsum brjod/ gdong g.yogs dkrol bar bsam mo/ /de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs shing mthong / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag dpe myu gu sngon po skyes pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa dang lam dngos dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya brten pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku sgrub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /brtul zhugs kyi rim pa bcu bzhi po kun bstan zin to/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya ba tshig tsam gyis bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba nas/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyabs tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong 'ching tshul bya/ de nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' ltar mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes brjod la/ de'i don ni khyod kyi dbang gsum pa'i dus su phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i rnam rtog thams cad 'gag cing / sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ngo bo shar ba de ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin la/ des mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes zung du 'jug pa de nyid/ dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi byed pa po ni rang gi sems yin/ sems kyi mtshan nyid kyang kun rdzob tu gsal zhing rig pa tsam de nyid/ phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i mthus/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bor snang ba yin la/

don dam par rang bzhin ci yang ma grub pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ de nyams su len par byed pa la/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag rgal tshigs drang por srang ba la sogs pa lus bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pas ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rtogs pa thams cad spangs te rang nyid lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa sgyu ma'i sku dang / sems nyid bde ba chen pos ros gang ba dang / de dag gi ngo bo ci yang ma grub pa'i stong pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /yang 'bru gsum brjod la gdong phye/ de lta na don dam par byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs shing mthong / dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dpe 'bras bu yongs su smin pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang / lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku sgrub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bya'o snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / dbang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun no/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma sta gon bzhin phul lo/ /slob ma dbang bskur shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i lū nag dbang gi mtshams sbyor ltar dgos na dkyil chog tu blta'o/ /spyi don bzhi pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phul/ de nas/ hūm̐ baṃ la sogs pa'i nang mchod/ mnyes mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / sogs gong bzhin brjod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can sogs bum bskyed bzhin/

sgrub mchod zhag sbrel te byed na/ nub dang po rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ gzhan rten bzhugs gshegs gsol spyi dang 'dra/ de nas go cha gsum bkod tsham ngam sngags kyis bsrung ba/ dga' ba gsum dran pa/ smon lam bkra shis sogs byed/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i nyin bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi khyams kyi steng du spyan drangs la mchod bstod yan gong bzhin bya/ phur pa bsdus te gnas dben par bskyal/ de la mchod bstod ye shes pa gshegs gsol sogs gong ma'i yig cha na med pas mi dgos/ de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su langs te yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi mthar/ bla ma yi dam sogs kyi rten yod pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod me tog gtor nas rten bzhugs bya/ de nas/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang bum nang gi lha/ gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa rnams/ tshar gsum oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin du gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang po bshig la chos thams cad skye ba med pa yid la dran pas/ ngag tu a kā ro'i sngags brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi me ris nas dbus kyi mtshan ma nas spyi bor bzhag pa'i bar rdo rje rtses ri mo 'then/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan rnams la'ang 'then/ gzhan sgrub g.yog pa kha cig gis rdul tshon mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus te rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du blug thig rjes rnams dri bzang gis phyag len la bum chu slob dpon gyis blug sgrub g.yog pas thig rjes med par bsub bo chus phyis la rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de nas rang la go cha gsum dang tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba dga' ba gsum dran pa/ smon lam dang bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo'i phyogs bzhi'i zhabs la gzigs/ /pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog༞ /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la//byang chub sems dang tsan+dan dri chen gur gum chus/

/gang ba'i snod bzhis dpa' bo'i zhal la reg par spyod/ /bden pa des kyang༞ bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i gnas la legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng / /gnas la sogs pa dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa༞ bkra shis gang zhig sa steng gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+ma'i 'phreng / /zhing la sogs pa dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa༞ bkra shis gang zhig sa 'og gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i 'phreng / /lus la sogs pa dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ bden pa༞ /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshams rnams su/ /khwa gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'phrog gzugs gnyis ldan/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /bden pa༞ bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang / /yang dag spongs dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dbang po sogs/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bden pa༞ bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gu mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang / /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas ni rab tu brgyan par gyur pa yi/ /mu tig dra ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyangs/ /bden pa༞ bkra shis gang zhig rta bab pad+ma chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs/ /ri dwags dang bcas mdzes pa'i ba dan bcu drug legs 'phyar zhing / /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dag las chos kyis sgra sgrog pa/ /bden pa༞ bkra shis gang zhig yongs su bskor ba'i dngos grub brgyad rnams su/ /phyogs skyong brgyad dang zhing chen brgyad ni kun nas gnas pa la/ /gdong brnyan dang ldan zhing skyong brgyad ni nye bar gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang༞ bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad rab tu 'bar gyur cing / /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sprin chen brgyad ni rab tu 'dus gyur cig

/dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni kun nas gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde༞ bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu chen brgyad 'bab cing / /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro tshogs kyis gang / /sha za srin po 'byung po'i tshogs kyis nye bar bsten pa yi/ /bden pa des kyang༞ /bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur/ /rdo rje'i bla bres kun nas bres shing mda' yi dra ba ldan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng bas kun nas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog/ //ces dang gzhan yang chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ dkyil 'khor bri shul la me tog gi char dbab par bya'o/ /nyal ldang kha zas gyi rnal 'byor rnams dang 'bring 'dus kyi rnam bzhag rnams kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /ces dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha sgong skyes ltar bskyed pa lū hu pa'i lugs kyi sgrub dkyil nag 'gros bklag chog ma 'di yang / gdong dga' chos sde na sgrub mchod 'di gtong srol 'dug kyang / 'don bya phyag len gnyis ka la ma dag pa'i bsre lhad sna tshogs 'dug pa gdong dga' slob dpon tshigs rdo srang kha ba sangs rgyas bkra shis dang / las sna tshigs rdo lho ba dpal ldan 'od zer gnyis nas sgrub dkyil la zhus dag ngos bklag chog lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgya mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog nag po dkyil chog kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa'i bde mchog sgrub thabs mngal sgong sbyong tshul/ mchod phreng yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel bas mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lū nag dkyil chog zur 'debs khyad par bzhi ldan/
